def: The upward bias in the observed score of whichever variant you selected as best; with many variants and noisy scores, the winner looks better than it is.
An evaluation set owned and run by someone independent of the training team, used only for final decisions so nobody can optimise toward it.
Writing down the hypothesis, the deciding metrics, and the success threshold before running the experiment.
Comparing two methods at the same training FLOPs or tokens, so a gain reflects the method rather than extra compute.
How much a final score changes when the same training recipe is rerun with a different random seed.
When a measure becomes a target, it stops being a good measure; optimisation pressure finds ways to raise the metric without the underlying quality.
A result, stated in advance, that would end a research project.
